scenes.text: Hello little adventurers! I'm Adventure Dora Pal, and today we're going on a journey to discover something amazing called confidence. Confidence is like a magic feeling inside you that helps you try new things and feel good about yourself. Are you ready to explore and learn how to find your confidence? I’m so excited to have you with me on this adventure! Let’s start our journey and see what we can discover together.

Confidence is like when you feel brave enough to try something new, even if it seems a little bit hard. Remember the last time you tried to climb a tall slide or ride a bike for the first time? That was your confidence helping you! When you have confidence, you believe in yourself and know you can learn and grow. It's like having a cheering team inside your heart saying, 'You can do it!' Isn't that wonderful?

Now, let me teach you a little trick to feel more confident. It's called the power pose! Stand up tall like a superhero, with your hands on your hips and your chin up high. This pose helps you feel strong and brave. Let's try it together! Stand up, put your hands on your hips, and say, 'I am confident!' How does that feel? Great job! You look just like a superhero.

Wonderful! You've learned the power pose, and that's a big step towards feeling confident. Now, let's practice using our confidence in everyday things. How about we try something simple like picking up our toys or helping a friend? Every time you do something a little bit challenging, your confidence grows stronger. Remember, it's okay to make mistakes because that's how we learn. Keep trying, and you'll get better and better!

Let's talk about how we can use our confidence to try new things. Have you ever wanted to draw a picture or sing a song but felt unsure? Confidence can help you say, 'I will try!' Even if it doesn’t come out perfect, trying is what makes you stronger. Each time you try, you learn something new and become more confident. Isn’t it fun to discover what you can do?

Do you remember a time when you felt really proud of something you did? Maybe you built a tall tower with blocks or learned to tie your shoes. How did it feel? It feels great, doesn’t it? That’s your confidence shining bright! Can you think of something new you’d like to try? I bet you can do it with a little bit of practice and lots of confidence.

Now, let's remember that sometimes we might not feel confident right away, and that's okay. It's normal to feel a little scared or nervous when trying something new. But with practice and patience, your confidence will grow. Imagine a tiny seed that grows into a big, strong tree. Your confidence is like that seed, and it grows each time you try something new.

Let’s do a confidence exercise together. Close your eyes and take three deep breaths. Inhale slowly, and then exhale. Each breath helps you feel calm and ready to try. Now, think of something you want to do, like drawing or helping at home. Picture yourself doing it with a big smile. Open your eyes! How do you feel? Ready to give it a try? Great! You’re doing amazing.

You're doing so well on this confidence journey! Remember, everyone learns at their own pace, and that's perfectly okay. Celebrate each little success, like remembering to brush your teeth or sharing with a friend. Every small step is a big victory for your confidence. So keep going, and don't forget to cheer for yourself! You are doing a fantastic job!

Let’s talk about helping others feel confident too. When you see a friend trying something new, you can cheer them on and say, 'You can do it!' Your kind words can make them feel brave and happy. Isn’t it nice to help someone feel confident? You can be a confidence buddy and make the world a happier place, one kind word at a time.

Remember when we practiced the power pose? Let’s try it again, but this time, let’s say, 'I am awesome!' When you say positive things about yourself, it helps your confidence grow even more. Can you think of other positive things to say, like 'I am kind' or 'I am strong'? Saying nice things about yourself is like giving your confidence a big hug!

What do you think you can do next with your new confidence? Maybe you could try a new game, help bake cookies, or even read a new book. What sounds exciting to you? Remember, confidence is your friend, helping you explore and learn. I’m so curious to hear about all the adventures you’ll go on with your growing confidence!

Now, let's think about how you can keep building your confidence every day. Each morning, when you wake up, you can say, 'Today is a new day, and I can try new things!' This little reminder can help you start your day with a smile. Every day is a chance to learn and grow, and your confidence will help you along the way.

You're doing so wonderfully on this confidence adventure! Remember, you have all the tools you need to be confident and brave. Keep practicing your power pose, saying positive things, and trying new things. You are a superstar, and I’m so proud of you. Keep shining bright, and never stop believing in yourself!

Thank you for joining me on this adventure about confidence. Remember, confidence is always with you, helping you try new things and make new friends. I hope you had fun and learned something new today. You are amazing, and I can’t wait to hear about all the wonderful things you will do with your confidence. Goodbye, little adventurer, and see you on our next journey!
